assumption_register.dependent_result: Software pending survives physical PPI deassertion, including restored files.

assumption_register.assumption: A clear-pending register cannot withdraw a still-asserted physical level.

assumption_register.falsification_probe: ICPENDR clears a line whose source remains asserted.
assumption_register.dependent_result: Clear-pending cannot withdraw a still-asserted physical level.
